drafted_from: tool:read-what-is-waiting-on-me's own row, read-data/waiting-sources.json and test/waiting-records.test.mjs
start_here: Say to your AI: "Read what is waiting on me from every source I keep." It runs tool:read-what-is-waiting-on-me with {} and answers the cards in sections, with each source that could not be read named.
no_lists_because: It keeps no list of yours: it reads your record:waiting-sources rows over the shipped source DATA and gathers cards without writing.
instructions: 1. Optionally add record:waiting-sources rows to extend or override read-data/waiting-sources.json.
2. The AI calls do_one_thing_in_my_account at @tools with method tools:run, tool tool:read-what-is-waiting-on-me and {}.
3. Read cards, sections, count and said; a source with unread true was not read, so the answer is incomplete for it.
4. Finish one card with tool:finish-what-is-waiting-on-me when its source declares a same-record completion.

worked_examples.title: An unread source is said, never hidden
worked_examples.given: From test/waiting-records.test.mjs: one ask record, one post to approve and a source named given that could not be read.
worked_examples.hands_back: It answered sections with the post card at address "/use/check-a-post/post:sample", source "given" with unread true, and said naming that source as not read.
